# pnpm-package-manager

Generated with pnpm 12.3.4 (corepack, on the host) from a package.json that pins the package
manager (`"packageManager": "pnpm@12.3.4"`):

    HOME=<scratch> pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts

- pnpm-lock.yaml holds two YAML documents (both `lockfileVersion: '9.0'`): the first records the
  package manager's own installation (`packageManagerDependencies`: pnpm and its platform
  binaries `@pnpm/exe.*`), the second the project's lock file (ms 2.1.3). Both are packages
  pnpm downloads. Real-world example: vitejs/vite's pnpm-lock.yaml.
